title: ProtoArt Heat Pumps
description: Matterbridge plugin for ProtoArt ME_CN105_ATA_WIFI heat pumps

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)

humidity.title: Humidity (wireless thermometer)
humidity.description: "off": not exposed (default). "thermostat" (recommended): humidity is added to the thermostat itself and shown in its detail view. "separate": a separate humidity sensor per unit; Apple Home may then show the unit primarily as a humidity sensor.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in Apple Home and other controllers. Defaults to "Heat Pump N".

identity.title: Device identity
identity.description: "ip" (default) keeps the identity used by earlier versions. "mac" uses the unit's MAC address, so the device survives IP changes. Switching an existing device to "mac" makes controllers see it as a new device.

hosts.title: ProtoArt hosts (legacy, comma-separated)
hosts.description: Deprecated: use "Heat pumps" above. Only used when that list is empty. e.g. 192.168.0.151,192.168.0.152

deviceNames.title: Device names (legacy, comma-separated)
deviceNames.description: Deprecated: use "Heat pumps" above. Matched to the legacy hosts by position.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often each unit is polled (minimum 5000). Failing units are polled less often (exponential backoff, max 2 min).
